subject: Recap: Decision journey & milestone owners for Skylabs pilot
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@skylabs.ai>, Rosa Martinez <rosa.martinez@skylabs.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 07 Aug 2026 14:10:00 -0700
Subject: Recap: Decision journey & milestone owners for Skylabs pilot

Hi Liam / Rosa —

Thanks again for the time this morning. Quick recap of what we heard and the proposed next steps so we can lock the right stakeholders in and avoid surprises as you move toward an internal procurement review. If anything below looks off, flag it and I'll update.

High-level pain & goals (from our call)
- Query latency for customer chat is causing session drop-offs; current average is ~1.2s per token on your on-prem model for common flows.
- Cost unpredictability when traffic spikes (marketing events). Goal is predictable per-conversation cost with 95th percentile latency under 300ms for standard queries.
- Compliance: audit logs and KMS integration required for pilot.

Proposed Decision Journey (milestones, target dates, and owners)
1) Pilot scope & success metrics agreed — due 2026-08-14 — owner: Rosa Martinez (Skylabs PM)
2) Security questionnaire + KMS sample config — due 2026-08-18 — owner: Liam O'Connor (Skylabs infra)
3) Redwood pilot environment provisioned (private VPC) — due 2026-08-21 — owner: Olga Petrov (Redwood CS)
4) Performance baseline run & tuning — due 2026-09-01 — owner: Ben Carter (Redwood AE / Eng ops)
5) Procurement review & contract close (pilot purchase order) — due 2026-09-10 — owner: Skylabs procurement (TBC)

Open items / asks for Skylabs
- Confirm procurement contact and expected PO timeline (add name & email).
- Share the SOC2 scope doc or a point of contact for security/legal so we can accelerate the questionnaire.
- Approve the attached MAP (Skylabs-MAP-v1.xlsx) which has the same milestones and acceptance criteria.

Attachments sent: Skylabs-MAP-v1.xlsx (milestone workbook) — see Drive link above. I'll also circulate a short SOW draft once procurement contact is confirmed.

Next calls
- 30-min decision sync w/ procurement + infra: propose Tue 2026-08-17 10:00 AM PT (please confirm availability).

If you approve the milestones above, we'll lock resources and begin VPC provisioning next week.

Best,

--
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwoodinference.com
Schedule a time: https://calendly.com/jasmine-redwood

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@skylabs.ai>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 07 Aug 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap: Decision journey & milestone owners for Skylabs pilot

Jasmine — thanks for the clear summary. A few quick clarifications:

- Procurement contact is me for now (Liam), but legal/procurement will loop in after we have an internal cost estimate. I will confirm the official PO owner by Monday.
- For security: legal wants a quick proof of audit log retention and an outline of KMS integration steps. I can share our SOC2 scope doc; will attach separately.
- The proposed dates look reasonable, but can we move the provisioning target one business day earlier (2026-08-20) to fit our internal staging window?

Also: can you include an estimated monthly cost range in the SOW draft (ballpark for the pilot size we discussed)? Even a tiered estimate (baseline | peak) will help move this to procurement.

Thanks — I'll confirm PO owner Monday and upload the SOC2 excerpt to the Drive link.

Use existing pilot template; note that procurement will want line items for reserved capacity vs burst. Target: SOW-draft-v0.1.pdf by EOD Monday (2026-08-10).

I'll keep Liam and Rosa in the loop. If procurement contact changes, we'll pivot but let's assume Liam as point for now.

Thanks for pulling this together. Confirming the milestones as listed (with the 2026-08-20 provisioning date). A couple of notes from the PM side:

- I'll be the program owner for the pilot scope & success metrics; I'll send a short doc that maps our KPIs to each milestone by Monday morning.
- Procurement: Liam will route the PO, but legal wants a draft SOW before routing. Please treat the SOW-draft-v0.1.pdf as the primary artifact for legal.
- Kickoff: we can do a 60-min kickoff the week of 2026-08-23. Proposed dates: Wed 2026-08-25 9:00 AM PT or Thu 2026-08-26 11:00 AM PT — I'll confirm after I get the KPI doc to you.

I've reviewed the attached MAP and it's good to go aside from a minor acceptance criterion tweak on the performance baseline (we require 95th percentile end-user latency <350ms for UI flows).

Please send the SOW and provisioning checklist to me and Liam once ready.

Thanks,
Rosa
